about.title: Murrieta Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seven people died in Murrieta traffic collisions in 2025, out of 426 injury crashes recorded citywide. Each of those numbers is a family in Riverside County trying to make sense of an empty chair. If someone you love was killed because another driver, property owner, or company acted carelessly along Murrieta Hot Springs Road, Clinton Keith Road, Whitewood Road, Winchester Road, or anywhere else in the city, California law gives certain relatives the right to bring a wrongful death claim. That claim is civil, separate from any criminal charges, and it exists to address what your household actually lost: funeral and burial expenses, the income and support the person would have provided, and the love, companionship, and guidance that cannot be replaced. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Murrieta families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency. You talk through what happened, the attorney explains your options, and there is no fee unless your family recovers something.

whyChoose.title: Why Murrieta Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing, generally to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can tell you plainly whether you qualify and how multiple family members are handled in a single case.

items.title: The two-year clock, explained early
items.desc: Most California wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency may be responsible. Getting connected sooner means nothing is lost to a missed deadline.

items.title: A full accounting of what was lost
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have contributed, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so pursuing every part of that claim costs your family nothing up front.

items.question: The driver who caused the crash on Clinton Keith Road is facing criminal charges. Do we still need our own case?
items.answer: Yes, if your family wants compensation. A criminal prosecution is brought by the Riverside County District Attorney and focuses on punishment, not on your household's losses. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action that you control, and it can proceed whether or not the criminal case ends in a conviction.

items.question: We're not sure which relatives are allowed to bring the claim. How does that work in California?
items.answer: California gives priority to the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children of the person who died. If there are none, certain dependents and heirs may have standing instead. An attorney can review your family situation and make sure everyone entitled to participate is included in one properly filed case.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything, and what does the attorney cost?
items.answer: LawProactive is completely free, and we are not a law firm. We connect you with an independent attorney in Murrieta who handles wrongful death claims on a contingency basis. That means there is no fee unless your family actually recovers compensation, and the initial conversation costs nothing.
